achondroplasia, Brachmann-de Lange syndrome, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, Marfan syn­
drome, myelomeningocele, Noonan’s syndrome, Prader-Willi syndrome, sickle cell disease, Silver-
Russell syndrome, Turner’s syndrome, Williams syndrome). Of note, classification of malnutrition 
has changed over time but some of the older classifications are still in use at this time, especially 
in hospital settings (Table 4-3).
